items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Earl had Ed Garlin, Earl Hines, and this little white trumpet player there... We only had a six piece lineup. Earl Hines, Donnell Howard, Ed Garlin, myself.

ctx.x: Oh, Ed Garlin, yeah. Well Ed Garlin had wrote me a letter and asked me about playing well and I told him he asked me because our band wasn't doing anything and I was willing to, you know, take the job until I could make a pretty good salary. So Doc had called me on long distance phone and told me, asked me how I'm ready if I wanted to come by plane or by train. I told him not before to come by train. So he sent me a ticket and I went on out there and that was August, the latter part of August 1955. Yeah. Because…
Who else was in the band then?
